newsitem.title: ITALY: Maximum rate 8.61 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Maximum rate 8.61 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 4.5 trillion lire six-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.61 percent, compared with 8.60 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.59 percent against 8.56 percent at the last reverse repurchase pact for nine trillion lire and 10 days on October 15.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for repurchase on October 23. The Bank said it received 38 bids of which seven were met in full and two in part.
